page_title: ROM 2-0 SAS | AS Roma v Sassuolo 10/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) does well on the edge of the box to find space and powers a shot in on goal that just goes over the bar.
90+4' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90+3' Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90+2' Manu Kone (AS Roma) receives a decent pass from Mario Hermoso and immediately goes for goal from mid-range. It's a fine strike but the ball goes just over the bar.
90+1' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies well wide of the left post.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) attempts to release Stephan El Shaarawy with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
90' Corner kicks – 5:2.
88' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) releases Luca Moro with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
87' Today's match ends for Matias Soule who will be replaced by Alessandro Romano (AS Roma).
87' The referee signals a substitution. Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Zeki Celik.
87' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Gianluca Mancini will be replaced by Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma).
85' Nemanja Matic (Sassuolo) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
84' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicholas Pierini (Sassuolo) comes onto the pitch so that Armand Lauriente can be given a rest.
83' Fabio Grosso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Edoardo Iannoni (Sassuolo) replacing Ismael Kone.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Pinamonti departs the field of play to be replaced by Luca Moro (Sassuolo).
82' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) gets to the ball in the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He didn't hit the ball properly and skies it high over the crossbar.
81' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) gets in a good position to shoot just outside the box after a nice pass, but his effort is unintentionally blocked by one of his teammate.
79' 2 - 0 Goal - 2:0! Stephan El Shaarawy tees up Matias Soule (AS Roma) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Arijanet Muric.

76' 1 - 0 Goal! Matias Soule hands Manu Kone (AS Roma) the simplest of tasks from close range after the cross evaded the keeper, and he makes no mistake with his header into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
76' The resulting corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
76' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. AS Roma get a corner.
74' The attendance is 60713.
73' Here is a change. Alieu Fadera is going off and Fabio Grosso gives the last tactical orders to Walid Cheddira (Sassuolo).
72' The substitution is prepared. Aster Vranckx (Sassuolo) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Luca Lipani.
71' Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

70' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) attempts to whip a quick pass into the box, but Paulo Dybala was not able to dribble past the opponent's defence and loses the ball. Arijanet Muric makes a brilliant save! Manu Kone (AS Roma) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.

69' Ambitious effort from Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post.
68' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 14:5. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:3.
67' Wesley Franca (AS Roma) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
66' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

66' A lofted cross from Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out for a corner. AS Roma can continue in their attacking effort.
62' It is time for a substitution. Wesley Franca (AS Roma) is on for Konstantinos Tsimikas.
61' Arijanet Muric blocks Manu Kone (AS Roma)'s effort from the edge of the box.

61' NO PENALTY! Referee Matteo Marcenaro has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The AS Roma players are incensed. Matias Soule (AS Roma) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
60' Celebrations by AS Roma are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
59' Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

59' Arijanet Muric (Sassuolo) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for an infringement. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for AS Roma!
59' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
58' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for AS Roma.
56' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is quick to pick up the loose pass from Paulo Dybala. He tries his luck from mid-range, but it goes well wide of the right post.
55' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

54' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Arijanet Muric stops the ball from hitting the bottom left corner. Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
51' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
50' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
50' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
49' Stephan El Shaarawy is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
49' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' Referee Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.

45+1' The cross into the penalty area from Matias Soule (AS Roma) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' The ball falls kindly for Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies high over the bar.
43' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) takes the corner but it's cleared.
40' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
39' The corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is hurriedly cleared.
39' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) is substituted due to injury. Gian Piero Gasperini gives a chance to Stephan El Shaarawy.

38' What a wasted opportunity by Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Mile Svilar makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
36' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
35' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort. He produces a poor shot which goes well over the crossbar.
35' A cross from Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

34' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Matias Soule, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
33' Manu Kone (AS Roma) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
32' The players claim that Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
31' The total number of attempts is 4:3. The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
25' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

25' Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the right post. Mile Svilar pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Sassuolo.
24' The free kick is delivered by Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
24' Gian Piero Gasperini appears to have said too much and referee Matteo Marcenaro comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
23' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
22' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Manu Kone (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
21' Matias Soule (AS Roma) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
21' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
20' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Zeki Celik (AS Roma).
18' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.

17' Ismael Kone (Sassuolo) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Mile Svilar makes a great save to stop his effort. Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is furious with himself as he misses a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box. He sends a rebound a few inches wide of the left post.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 64:36.
15' The game is interrupted now, Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
14' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is penalised for holding. Matteo Marcenaro signals a set piece.
13' Konstantinos Tsimikas (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arijanet Muric, who smothers the ball.
12' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
11' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' Great teamplay by AS Roma as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

7' That didn't go as planned! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom left corner was too weak to get past Arijanet Muric, who easily kept it out.
5' Good defending. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) tries to find Evan Ferguson inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
4' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Alieu Fadera (Sassuolo) offside.
4' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
2' Jay Idzes (Sassuolo) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
1' That's unlucky! Matias Soule (AS Roma) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
1' The first half has just begun.
AS Roma will kick-off.
